title: Plot episode returns and their moving average
description: You display raw learning returns alongside a smoothed series.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You plot returns with partial transparency and label the series episode return. Each entry supplies one plotted episode value.

steps.question: What weight does each entry of the smoothing kernel receive?
steps.answer: Each kernel entry receives one divided by the supplied window width. np.convolve applies that equal-weight kernel with mode=same.

steps.description: You compute ma and plot it over the raw returns. Its legend label includes the window width.
You label the axes Episode and Return and display the Q-learning curve. The supplied output includes no numeric series from which to assess improvement.
